_demo: The §13 individuation dogfood. A GENERIC 'is it viable?' would average to a comfortable number and HIDE the weak part. Individuating the SPECIFIC object into its real parts (engine 0.90 / protocol 0.85 / empirical-claim 0.15) makes the branch children diverge (stdev >= conflict_delta) → the engine fires inconclusive:[conflict:what] and lands MEDIUM ~0.70. Individuation SURFACES the divergence the average would bury (anti-theater R2/R3 by construction). It also honestly encodes that p_claim=0.15 because E2/E3 are NOT done — capability shipped, validation still gated.
